description: 高潮浸水想定区域図 [flood and storm surge and coastal flooding] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 東京都港湾局. 【東京都港湾局】東京都港湾局ホームページ（ kouwan. metro. tokyo. lg. jp/）に公表している高潮浸水想定区域図のデータです。 ＜高潮浸水想定区域図のポイント＞ ・我が国既往最大規模の台風（室戸台風級：911hPa）を想定 ・東京湾に最大の高潮を想定させるような台風の経路を設定 ・高潮と同時... Coverage: Tokyo, Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 東京都港湾局. Its tags are デジタルツイン. It offers 7 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
